t: Designed for use on stationary circular saws for cutting natural woods and composite materials such as formwork. Ultra-thin kerf for quick, smooth cuts with low cutting force. Enable simple to good lateral and longitudinal cutting results. Teeth are designed to resist damage should they impact foreign objects such as embedded nails and concrete. Suitable for first fix application where cut finish is less important and re-used timbers are often used.
b: For use with Chop, Mitre & Table Saws
Ultra-Thin Kerf for Quick, Smooth Cuts
